records.jp: ……えっと、どうしたの？
records.en_original: ...Um, what's wrong?
records.en_auxiliary: Um, what's wrong?
records.en: ...Um, what's going on?

records.jp: どうもしていないわ。<CR>やけにこちらを見てくるから、見返しているだけよ
records.en_original: Nothing's wrong. She's staring at me, so I'm staring back.
records.en_auxiliary: Nothing's wrong. She's staring at me, so I'm staring back.
records.en: Nothing is wrong.<CR>She kept looking at me, so I am merely looking back.

records.jp: まあ、いわゆる観察というものだ
records.en_original: Call it observation.
records.en_auxiliary: Call it observation.
records.en: This is what one would call observation.

records.jp: 他の生徒とは異なる気配、立ち居振る舞い、<CR>そして最も異質なのはその思考回路――
records.en_original: Her presence, demeanor, and above all thought process differ from the from the other students at this school...
records.en_auxiliary: Her presence, demeanor, and, above all, thought process differ from the other students at this school.
records.en: Her presence, bearing,<CR>and above all, her thought process differ from the other students...

records.jp: 人間と一口に言っても、こういう変異種が<CR>いるというのは興味深いものだ
records.en_original: It's quite interesting to see such a mutant species among the humans here.
records.en_auxiliary: It's quite interesting to see such a mutant species among the humans here.
records.en: Even among humans, it is interesting<CR>that such a variant exists.

records.jp: 本人を前にして、ずいぶんな物言いね
records.en_original: And that's quite a thing to say to my face.
records.en_auxiliary: And that's quite a thing to say to my face.
records.en: And that's quite a thing to say to my face.

records.jp: （あはは……有理、肝が据わっているというか<CR>何というか……私にはできないなぁ）
records.en_original: (Ahaha... Yuri has nerves of steel or something... I could never do that.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Ahaha... Yuri has nerves of steel or something. I could never be that blunt.)
records.en: (Ahaha... Yuri is fearless, or something like that.<CR>I could never say such a thing.)

records.jp: まあ、変異種という点は私も同じか……
records.en_original: Although I'd say I'm a mutant species, as well...
records.en_auxiliary: Although, I'd say I'm a mutant species, as well.
records.en: Though I suppose I am a variant as well...

records.jp: ……勝手に同じにしないでくれる？<CR>私という存在は唯一無二なのよ
records.en_original: ...Don't lump me in with you. I'm unique, the one and only me.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't lump me in with you. I'm unique! The one and only me.
records.en: Don't group me with you without permission.<CR>I'm a one-of-a-kind existence.

records.jp: そうか……それはすまなかったな
records.en_original: I see... I didn't mean to offend.
records.en_auxiliary: I see. I didn't mean to offend.
records.en: I see... My apologies.

records.jp: だが、どうすれば唯一無二の人間像が<CR>成立するのかは考察する価値がありそうだ
records.en_original: However, I think it's very worth studying such a unique human being, and how you came about.
records.en_auxiliary: However, I think it's very worth studying such a unique human being and how you came about.
records.en: Still, it seems worth examining<CR>how a one-of-a-kind person comes to exist.

records.jp: どうすれば……？<CR>そんなこと、いちいち気にしたことがないわ
records.en_original: How I came about...? I've never worried about that stuff.
records.en_auxiliary: Like an origin story? I've never worried about that stuff.
records.en: How I came about...?<CR>I've never worried about that stuff.

records.jp: そこにいる白井の方が、<CR>よほどそういうことには詳しいでしょうね
records.en_original: I'm sure Shirai over there would know more about what makes me who I am than I do.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure Shirai over there would know more about what makes me who I am than I do.
records.en: Shirai over there<CR>probably knows far more about such matters.

records.jp: え、私？
records.en_original: Huh, me?
records.en_auxiliary: Who? Me?
records.en: Huh, me?

records.jp: いつも他人の心に踏み入る活動をしているのだから、<CR>詳しくなっていてもおかしくはないでしょう？
records.en_original: You're always forcing your way into people's hearts. It wouldn't be surprising if you knew.
records.en_auxiliary: You're always forcing your way into people's hearts. It wouldn't be surprising if you knew.
records.en: You're always engaged in activities that enter other people's hearts.<CR>It wouldn't be strange for you to know, would it?

records.jp: ふ、踏み入るって……否定はできないけど……
records.en_original: F-Forcing my way in...? I can't exactly deny that, but...
records.en_auxiliary: F-forcing my way in?! I can't exactly deny that, but...
records.en: F-Forcing my way in...? I can't exactly deny that, but...

records.jp: うーん……やっぱり、自信に溢れているから……かな
records.en_original: Hmm... I think it's because she's brimming with confidence...?
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm. I think it's because she's brimming with confidence?
records.en: Hmm... I think it's because she's so confident.

records.jp: 不安だと他の人の考え方に流されちゃうこともあるし、<CR>堂々としていることも難しいから
records.en_original: If you're uneasy, you follow along with what other people think, and it's hard to stand your ground.
records.en_auxiliary: If you're uneasy, you follow along with what other people think, and it's hard to stand your ground.
records.en: When you feel uncertain, you may be swept along by others' opinions,<CR>and it becomes difficult to carry yourself proudly.

records.jp: 麻央は自分に自信を持ってるし、<CR>だからこそ自分の考え方を曲げずにいられるんだよね
records.en_original: Mao is full of self confidence. That's why she doesn't bend and stands by her own ways of thinking.
records.en_auxiliary: Mao is full of self-confidence. That's why she doesn't bend and stands by her own ways of thinking.
records.en: Mao is confident in herself,<CR>and that's exactly why she sticks to her own way of thinking.

records.jp: あら、やけに肯定的な評価をするのね。<CR>何か裏でもあるのかしら？
records.en_original: Well, that's an awfully positive view of me... What's your ulterior motive?
records.en_auxiliary: Well, that's an awfully positive view of me. What's your ulterior motive?
records.en: Well, that's an awfully positive view of me...<CR>What's your ulterior motive?

records.jp: いや……見たままっていうか、<CR>思ったままのことを言っただけなんだけどね……
records.en_original: I don't have one... I just told her what I've seen, or maybe more like the way I think things are.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't have one. I just told her what I've seen, or at least, the way I think things are.
records.en: No... I only said what I saw,<CR>or rather, exactly what I thought...

records.jp: 自信……なるほど、いつも自信に溢れているがゆえの差か。<CR>それならば、自信を持てば唯一無二となるわけだ
records.en_original: Confidence... I see, the key difference is confidence. Thus, being confident results in uniqueness.
records.en_auxiliary: Confidence. I see, the key difference is confidence. Thus, being confident results in uniqueness.
records.en: Confidence... I see. The difference comes from always being full of confidence.<CR>Then possessing confidence makes one unique.

records.jp: そんなもの、言うだけなら簡単よ。<CR>自信を保つための努力ができない人には、一生無理でしょうね
records.en_original: Easy enough to say. But you need to work hard to keep your confidence. If you don't, it counts for nothing.
records.en_auxiliary: Easy enough to say. But you need to work hard to keep your confidence. If you don't, it counts for nothing.
records.en: That's easy enough to say.<CR>Anyone unwilling to work to maintain their confidence will never achieve it.

records.jp: 自信を持つこと、そしてそれを保つ努力をすること……か
records.en_original: Having confidence, and doing the work to preserve it...
records.en_auxiliary: Having confidence, and doing the work to preserve it...
records.en: Having confidence, and doing the work to preserve it...

records.jp: 有理は、自分の研究に自信を持つだけでもいいんじゃないかな。<CR>ああいう研究って、誰にでもできることじゃないし
records.en_original: You should just be confident in your research, Yuri. It's not something just anyone can do.
records.en_auxiliary: You should just be confident in your research, Yuri. It's not something just anyone can do.
records.en: Maybe you only need to have confidence in your research, Yuri.<CR>That kind of research isn't something just anyone can do.

records.jp: なるほど……他人と同様の方法で、<CR>私も唯一の存在になることができるんだな
records.en_original: I see... So, while it may be a well-trodden path, confidence can make people individually unique.
records.en_auxiliary: I see. So, while it may be a well-trodden path, confidence can make people individually unique.
records.en: I see... By using the same means as others,<CR>I too can become a unique individual.

records.jp: ……もういいかしら。私も暇じゃないのよ
records.en_original: ...Are we done here? I'm not made of free time.
records.en_auxiliary: Are we done here? I'm not made of free time.
records.en: ...Are we done? I have things to do too.

records.jp: ああ、貴重な話、感謝する
records.en_original: We are. Thank you for the valuable information.
records.en_auxiliary: We are. Thank you for the valuable information.
records.en: Yes. Thank you for the valuable information.

records.jp: （最初はひやひやしたけど、<CR>有理も得るものがあったみたいでよかった……）
records.en_original: (I was a little worried at first, but I'm glad Yuri got something out of this...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I was a little worried at first, but I'm glad Yuri got something out of this.)
records.en: (I was a little worried at first,<CR>but I'm glad Yuri got something out of this...)

records.jp: （……私も、自信をつけなくちゃ）
records.en_original: (...I need to have confidence, too.)
records.en_auxiliary: (...I need to have confidence, too.)
records.en: (...I need to have confidence, too.)

records.jp: 麻央は芸能人としての生活が長いし……<CR>他のみんなと違うところがあってもおかしくはないんじゃないかな？
records.en_original: Mao's lived the celebrity life for a long time... I wouldn't be surprised parts of her are different from others.
records.en_auxiliary: Mao's lived the celebrity life for a long time. I wouldn't be surprised parts of her are different from others.
records.en: Mao's lived as an entertainer for a long time,<CR>so it wouldn't be strange for her to differ from everyone else.

records.jp: ふむ……育った境遇の違い、というわけか。<CR>どのような境遇だとそうなるのかはわからないが……
records.en_original: Hmm... So it's a difference of upbringing? Though I have no idea what kind of environment results in this...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm. So it's a difference of upbringing? Though I have no idea what kind of environment results in this.
records.en: Hmm... Then it is a difference in the environment in which she was raised.<CR>Though I do not know what sort of environment produces that result...

records.jp: ……他の人とは違う境遇。<CR>それだけで十分でしょう、無闇に人を詮索しないことね
records.en_original: ...A different one. That's all you need to know. You shouldn't pry into other people's lives so much.
records.en_auxiliary: ...A different one. That's all you need to know. You shouldn't pry into other people's lives so much.
records.en: ...An environment different from other people's.<CR>That's all you need to know. Don't pry into others without cause.

records.jp: それもそうだな……
records.en_original: Perhaps you're right...
records.en_auxiliary: Perhaps, you're right...
records.en: Perhaps you're right...

records.jp: 異なる集団に属する者が一人だけ画一的な集団に混じっていれば、<CR>他と違って見えるのも道理か
records.en_original: If a single person from a different group joins a uniform group, they obviously appear different from the others.
records.en_auxiliary: If a single person from a different group joins a uniform group, they obviously appear different from the others.
records.en: If one person belonging to a different group enters a uniform group,<CR>it is natural that she would appear different from the rest.

records.jp: そうすると、まずは画一的な集団とは何か、<CR>どのような生活をしてきた者たちを指すのか追究せねば……
records.en_original: In that case, first I should study the uniform group to figure out exactly what it is, and the lives they lead...
records.en_auxiliary: In that case, first I should study the uniform group to figure out exactly what it is, and the lives they lead.
records.en: Then first I must determine what constitutes a uniform group,<CR>and what kind of lives its members have led...

records.jp: ……そろそろ付き合いきれないから、もう行くわ。<CR>ただでさえ、時間の無駄でしかないのに
records.en_original: ...I can't take much more of this, I'm out of here. What a waste of time.
records.en_auxiliary: I can't take much more of this, I'm out of here. What a waste of time.
records.en: ...I can't keep indulging you, so I'm leaving.<CR>This has already been nothing but a waste of time.

records.jp: あはは……
records.en_original: Ahaha.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha.
records.en: Ahaha.

records.jp: （それでも律儀に話を聞いてた辺り、<CR>麻央なりに応じようとしてくれてたのかも……？）
records.en_original: (Still, she was listening to what we had to say. I guess that's Mao trying to accommodate us, in her own way...?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Still, she was listening to what we had to say. I guess that's Mao trying to accommodate us in her own way?)
records.en: (Still, she stayed and listened to us the whole time.<CR>Maybe that was Mao's way of trying to meet us halfway...?)

records.jp: 麻央は――
records.en_original: Mao's so different...
records.en_auxiliary: Mao's so different...
records.en: Mao is—
